title: Social Intifada Launches Official Website
summary: The Social Intifada website is now live, offering a new space for stories, insights, and conversation.
asideNote: Secure your place before event day.
body:
Social Intifada has officially launched its new website, marking a significant step in expanding its digital presence. The platform aims to provide news, analysis, and perspectives on social and political issues from around the world.

The website is designed to serve as a central hub for content, offering readers accessible coverage, opinion pieces, and updates on current events. Organizers say the launch reflects a broader effort to strengthen engagement and reach a wider audience online.

With its debut, Social Intifada joins a growing number of independent platforms seeking to shape conversations and provide alternative viewpoints in the digital media space.

Islamic Relief is a national charity partner. Website: islamic-relief.org.za.

title: The Voice of Hind Rajab - Cape Town: Nu Metro, Canal Walk (11:00)
summary: A South African screening of The Voice of Hind Rajab with Social Intifada as the official South African partner.
posterAlt: The Voice of Hind Rajab - Cape Town: Nu Metro, Canal Walk (11:00)
asideNote: Booking updates for this newly added show will be shared via Social Intifada.
body:
On January 29, 2024, Red Crescent volunteers received an emergency call. A 5-year-old girl was trapped in a car under IOF fire in Gaza, pleading for rescue. While trying to keep her on the line, they did everything they could to get an ambulance to her. Her name was Hind Rajab.

Receiving a 23-minute standing ovation at its world premiere in Venice, The Voice of Hind Rajab received an Academy Award nomination for Best International Feature Film, with nominations at the Golden Globes and the BAFTAs.

Social Intifada is honoured to serve as the official South African partner for The Voice of Hind Rajab Film.

Islamic Relief is a national charity partner. Website: islamic-relief.org.za.

This newly added Canal Walk screening takes place at 11:00. Follow Social Intifada on X for updates: x.com/socialintifada.
